A lean gaunt pale human man, bald scarred high forehead, deep-set alert yellow-brown eyes, severe bony brows and ears; dirty ivory cloth bandages cover lower nose, jaw and mouth. Three-quarter close head and shoulders; battered dark purple leather mantle with a small brass clasp, one battered green-glass chemical tube and corroded iron collar low at shoulder. Physical worn cloth, scar tissue, corroded metal. Background old Zaun laboratory window and tiny green vial, subordinate to bright face. Separate specialty object in right panel: one small sealed alchemist glass ampoule with visible shiny SILVERY LIQUID MERCURY pooled inside, iron cap and practical dark iron holder on a folded brown workcloth. No skull, no face, no poison cloud. It represents a bounded native +1 mercury per day resource specialty, not healing, poison trails or a living creature.
